title: Four Million People Sit Behind the Bailout Request
subtitle: Russian e-commerce employs around four million people and accounts for a combined 8% to 10% of the economy. That is the leverage its owners now hold over the budget.

source.name: Russian e-commerce sector employment and output estimates

supportingFacts.label: The combined share attributed to the sector, and a share that has been growing rather than shrinking.
The larger the employment base, the harder it becomes for the state to refuse compensation to the platform owners.
If compensation is granted at the scale requested, it becomes budget money that does not reach the army.

metadata.keyFinding: Around four million jobs and 8-10% of the economy underwrite the sector's bailout demands.
